title: AI CO-PILOT RECIPE: CONTENT FACTORY (VARIANT B)

sections.title: ⚠️ THE REALITY CHECK
sections.content: AI defaults to a generic corporate 'AI voice'. It will also hallucinate facts to sound convincing. **Always verify:** Manual fact-check is mandatory.

sections.title: 🗺️ THE BIG PICTURE
sections.content:
**Global View:** High-speed production of distinct, brand-aligned technical content.
**Motivation:** Scale your publishing without losing your soul to boilerplate fluff.

sections.title: 🛠️ THE SETUP
sections.content:
**Prerequisites:**
- Brand Voice Guide
- Outline Template
- Target Audience ICP

sections.title: 🚀 PHASE 1: BLUEPRINT
sections.content:
**Desc:** Define Brand Voice & Brief.
**The Prompt:** *'Act as a technical editor and outline a 1000-word post on X.'*
**Point of Failure:** Outline contains irrelevant fluff.
**The Fix:** Delete weak headers manually.

sections.title: 🚀 PHASE 2: BUILD
sections.content:
**Desc:** Iterative Drafting.
**The Prompt:** *'Write H2 section 1. Keep paragraphs < 3 sentences. No forbidden words.'*
**Point of Failure:** AI ignores negative constraints.
**The Fix:** Repeat constraints in every prompt.

sections.title: 🚀 PHASE 3: AUDIT
sections.content:
**Desc:** Fact & Tone Check.
**Manual Check:** Does this sound like a human wrote it?
**Guardrails:** Run through Grammarly/Copyscape to ensure originality and tight logic.

sections.title: 🚀 PHASE 4: SHIP
sections.content:
**Desc:** Formatting & SEO.
**The Prompt:** *'Generate 3 meta titles < 60 chars.'*
**Expected:** Publish-ready technical content.

sections.title: 🛡️ GUARDRAILS & TESTS
sections.content: **Validation:** Never ask AI to 'write the whole post'. Modular generation ensures quality control. Use the 'Feynman Technique' audit: ask AI to explain the core concept back to you to find logic gaps.

sections.title: 🔭 NEXT STEPS
sections.content:
**Future Learning:** Automate content distribution via Buffer API.
**Links:** Writing guides at `technicalwriting.org`.
